description: Navigator-maintained browser session and BurpBridge auth-context mirror
note: This file stores dynamic auth data, session health, and resume context. Security may read auth_context as the local mirror before replay retries.

session_schema.role: Role name such as admin, user, guest
session_schema.visible_browser_verified: Whether the browser instance is visible and verified
session_schema.last_verified_title: Last page title verified by Navigator
session_schema.auth_context.cookies: Cookie dictionary synced from the browser session
session_schema.auth_context.headers: Auth-related request headers used by BurpBridge replay
session_schema.auth_context.last_synced_at: When the local auth-context mirror was last refreshed
session_schema.auth_state.needs_reauth: Whether this session currently requires reauthentication
session_schema.resume_context.resume_target_url: Preferred URL to resume after recovery
session_schema.resume_context.pending_urls: URLs that still need processing after recovery
session_schema.runtime_control.auto_sync_expected: Whether Security currently expects auto sync to be enabled
session_schema.runtime_control.auto_sync_verified_at: When auto sync was last verified
session_schema.runtime_control.auto_sync_last_repair_at: When auto sync was last repaired
session_schema.runtime_control.auto_sync_owner: Agent currently responsible for the auto sync requirement
session_schema.history_progress: Security history scan and replay cursor state

status_definitions.stale: Session should be rechecked or pre-refreshed soon
status_definitions.closed: Session was closed and kept only for history
